title: Closing-Year Care Share for Larkspur Care Stays on the Entrance Fee Agreement Tax Letter
content:
Larkspur care stays charged in the closing year of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** are added to its closing-year tax letter at a closing-year care share: where the closing year holds Post-Hospital Recovery Stay nights the share is 1.0, where it holds Assisted Living Respite Stay or Memory Care Respite Stay nights but no recovery nights the share is 0.6, and otherwise the share is 0; the share applies to the closing-year care-stay charges the resident bore.

The closing-year care-stay charges are the nightly charges of Larkspur care stays, every stay type other than the Independent Living Trial Stay, posted in the closing year. The care-stay share so obtained is added to the letter's medical expense amount before its single rounding to the cent half up.

## Records read

Nightly charge entries on the resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger in the closing year, by stay type: Post-Hospital Recovery Stay; Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care), (Enhanced Care) or (Extensive Care); Memory Care Respite Stay.

## Share ladder

| Nights in the closing year | Closing-year care share |
|---|---|
| Any Post-Hospital Recovery Stay nights | 1.0 |
| Assisted Living or Memory Care Respite Stay nights, no recovery nights | 0.6 |
| Neither | 0 |

## Hypothetical closing years

| Nights | Share | Charges borne | Added to the letter |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 recovery nights | 1.0 | 6200.00 | 6200.00 |
| 5 assisted living respite nights (Enhanced Care) | 0.6 | 2250.00 | 1350.00 |
| 4 Independent Living Trial Stay nights only | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
